title: Empty book
subtitle: Price steps inside ±2% of the mid with very little resting size. A thinner side is the way price can move with less size in the way.
easierUp: Easier up — less size above the price
easierDown: Easier down — less size below the price
easierEven: Both sides are a similar size
noGaps: No wide empty stretch in this band.
emptyHint: Load the market to see which pairs have a thinner path up or down.
